title: CSTC extraordinary meeting urges government action on workers' grievances and social dialogue
scope: A meeting of the components of the Confédération syndicale des travailleurs du Congo; source does not establish an open public protest or mass gathering.
organizer: Confédération syndicale des travailleurs du Congo (CSTC).
threshold_50_evidence: The source reports an extraordinary meeting but gives no attendance count and does not describe a public demonstration; no ≥50 evidence.

start_date.summary: ACI reports the meeting took place on 7 November.

location.summary: ACI places the meeting in Brazzaville; no venue is named.

organizer.summary: The meeting was convened by the CSTC and included its components.

demands.summary: Union bodies urged the President to resolve worker grievances and asked the government to improve labor-crisis management and hold social-dialogue sessions; the report also records explicit support for the President.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: No simultaneous attendance estimate and no open public protest characterization are provided.

state_response.summary: The account does not document an event-specific state response.

notes: Do not infer a protest from the meeting's grievances. The report's statement of unconditional support for the President makes the nature of the meeting politically mixed.
open_questions: Was the 7 November meeting open to the public or a closed union conference?
Did participants stage a public demonstration or only issue a post-meeting communiqué?
Do records identify a specific government decision or policy as the target?
